sections.title: Deal readiness
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,closing_on,status,closing_items,blockers,postclosing_open from closing_readiness order by closing_on

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select * from attention order by due_on nulls last,deal,code

sections.title: Current document signatures
sections.sql: select deal,code,signer,revision,signature_status,signed_on,evidence from signature_status order by deal,code,signer

sections.title: Outstanding obligations
sections.sql: select deal,code,title,owner,due_on from item_readiness where kind='postclosing' and status='open' order by due_on

sections.title: Privacy review reminders
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by deal,rule
